Name: Remainders
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Remainders, command: many)
SELECT id, positiveModulo(sensor, slot) AS positive, pmod(sensor, sensor) AS positive_wide,
    positive_modulo(wide, small) AS positive_small, modulo(wide, small) AS signed_remainder, wide % small AS operator_remainder,
    moduloOrZero(sensor, slot) AS remainder_or_zero, positiveModulo(level, slot) AS positive_float
FROM readings;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:positiveModulo(sensor, slot)⟩ AS positive, ⟨c2 aliased:pmod(sensor, sensor)⟩ AS positive_wide,
    ⟨c3 aliased:positive_modulo(wide, small)⟩ AS positive_small, ⟨c4 aliased:modulo(wide, small)⟩ AS signed_remainder, ⟨c5 aliased:wide % small⟩ AS operator_remainder,
    ⟨c6 aliased:moduloOrZero(sensor, slot)⟩ AS remainder_or_zero, ⟨c7 aliased:positiveModulo(level, slot)⟩ AS positive_float
FROM readings;

Name: Buckets
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Buckets, command: many)
SELECT id, widthBucket(level, 0, 100, buckets) AS bucket, width_bucket(level, 0, 100, toUInt32(buckets)) AS wide_bucket FROM readings;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:widthBucket(level, 0, 100, buckets)⟩ AS bucket, ⟨c2 aliased:width_bucket(level, 0, 100, toUInt32(buckets))⟩ AS wide_bucket FROM readings;
